title: Blueberry Chia Yogurt Cups
steps: Stir the chia seeds, ground flaxseed, and cinnamon into the yogurt.
Divide between four jars and top with the blueberries.
Chill at least 2 hours, so the chia softens and thickens the yogurt.
goldenRuleCallouts: Plain yogurt only — sweetened tubs are the added-sugar trap in a snack like this.
Berries and chia together cover fiber and omega-3s in one jar.
storageNotes: Refrigerate up to 3 days. The chia keeps absorbing liquid, so the cups thicken each day; loosen with a spoonful of milk or water if they get too stiff.
